description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Using Laser-Lines and Cameras to Measure Vertical Displacement is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jason DeJong, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This research describes the development of a new method of measurement used to solve geotechnical problems using image analysis through non-contact mechanisms in a simplified way. The approach developed and the research presented have demonstrated the flexibility and versatility of the developed method. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-6vt0-zb80. Keywords: NHERI Center for Geotechnical Modeling; Displacement; Settlement; Cameras; Lasers; Python. Published 2023-08-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
